causality_tests.failure_condition: Any target at or before the prefix boundary changes.
causality_tests.name: future_truncation
causality_tests.procedure: Remove every later price and funding row and compare exact prefix targets.

causality_tests.name: future_corruption
causality_tests.procedure: Append extreme non-finite rows at or after the decision and compare exact prefix targets.

causality_tests.failure_condition: Input order changes feature, membership, or target bytes.
causality_tests.name: deterministic_rerun
causality_tests.procedure: Reverse symbol, price-row, and funding-row order under seed 20260801.

causality_tests.failure_condition: A future, duplicate, stale, ineligible, missing, or non-grid row enters a feature.
causality_tests.name: availability_membership
causality_tests.procedure: Inject each violation and require exclusion or a fail-closed flat request.

decision_contract.rebalance_rule: integer 8h epoch index modulo 9 equals zero

derived_features.availability: 132 exact 8h returns through the lagged cutoff
derived_features.formula: M=fsum(42d returns ending 2d before cutoff); F=fsum(14d returns ending 1d before cutoff)
derived_features.missing_rule: all 133 exact positive closes required; no fill or older anchor

derived_features.availability: unique funding in [t-7d,t), >=7 events, newest age<=16h
derived_features.missing_rule: no fill; duplicate, stale, non-finite, insufficient, or abs(rate)>0.05 excludes symbol

derived_features.availability: >=30 complete current symbols before and >=24 after filter
derived_features.missing_rule: flat if filter, ranks, or cross section fail

derived_features.formula: K=max(6,floor(N/4)); top K long, bottom K short; equal B_eff=min(0.30,K*0.04)
derived_features.missing_rule: flat if sleeves, trend/funding polarity, cap, gross, or net invariant fails

forbidden_inputs: execution open or mark price as a feature
OHLC shape, quote volume, taker flow, or order book
common-market factor, beta, residual, regime label, or direction switch
position, fill, cost, equity, drawdown, or PnL
private/final observations, V1 results, other teams, ballots, or leaderboards

forward_diagnostic.embargo: 30 calendar days for any outcome-selected later candidate
forward_diagnostic.label: next scheduled three-day executable-open-to-open symbol return
forward_diagnostic.purge: labels are non-overlapping; reject malformed overlap
forward_diagnostic.required: pooled score IC>0 and score IC>0 in at least four of six folds

raw_inputs.coverage: organizer-streamed 8h transaction bars for current eligible symbols
organizer-streamed realized funding for current eligible symbols

raw_inputs.availability_timestamp: current decision after weekly causal reconstitution
raw_inputs.coverage: point-in-time Top-40 intersected with executable symbols
